name: sboot-rehost
description: Samsung firmware rehosting helper for QEMU — two tracks: (1) S-Boot BL3 shell, (2) kernel direct-boot + real vendor storage (UFS) controller model to real Android userspace. Runs autonomously by default (no mid-run prompts; decisions journaled). Drives static analysis, machine.c generation, iterative fault loop, and 5/5 honesty verification.
